name: crowdin

schema.description: Configuration for Crowdin, a crowd-translation platform.

append_commit_message.title: Append Commit Message
append_commit_message.description: Replace the default commit message with the one specified in commit_message.

export_languages.title: Export Languages
export_languages.description: Specify a list of specific languages to export.

translate_content.title: Translate Content
translate_content.description: Defines whether to translate texts placed inside the tags.

translate_attributes.title: Translate Attributes
translate_attributes.description: Defines whether to translate tags' attributes.

content_segmentation.title: Content Segmentation
content_segmentation.description: Defines whether to split long texts into smaller text segments.

translatable_elements.title: Translatable Elements
translatable_elements.description: An array of strings, where each item is the XPaths to DOM element that should be imported.

escape_quotes.title: Escape Quotes
escape_quotes.description: Defines whether a single quote should be escaped by another single quote or backslash in exported translations.

escape_special_characters.title: Escape Special Characters
escape_special_characters.description: Defines whether any special characters (=, :, ! and #) should be escaped by backslash in exported translations.

description:
The Crowdin project is identified by the numeric ID 123456, which can also be supplied via the environment variable **CROWDIN_PROJECT_ID**. Authentication uses the token abcd1234efgh5678ijkl, or alternatively the variable **CROWDIN_API_TOKEN**. All source files are rooted in the **./src** directory (or the path provided in **CROWDIN_BASE_PATH**) and the API endpoint is https://crowdin.com/api/v2 (overridable with **CROWDIN_BASE_URL**). The configuration preserves the original hierarchy, and each synchronization will use the commit message “Update translations from source files” without appending any additional text. Export is limited to French (fr), German (de) and Spanish (es).  

For the file set, every JSON file matching the glob src/**/*.json is processed, while any files under src/**/test/** are ignored. The translation output template /locales/%locale%/translation.json includes a placeholder replacement that maps %locale% to fr. The French and German locales are excluded from target translations for Japanese (ja) and Chinese (zh). The files are treated as JSON (scheme json, type json) and written to locales/%two_letters_code%/translation.json using the update option update_as_unapproved. Content, attributes and segmentation are all enabled (values 1). Only the elements selected by the XPaths //title and //description are imported. Untranslated strings and files are not skipped, but only approved translations are exported. Quotes are escaped using the “double‑quote” method (value 3) and special characters are escaped (value 1). The exported files do not include a header line. Language mappings translate zh‑CN to the two‑letter code zh (and Android code zh‑rCN) and pt‑BR to pt (and Android code pt‑rBR). Finally, the file is tagged with the labels “frontend” and “i18n”.
